description: A chat's Access…: its own rule for who in the mesh may manage it (list, read, write in, stop, rename, archive, delete it), which goes before its host's Agent Management rule. Title "Chat Access", the chat's title (a Bot's name) under it.
opens: session row right-click → Access… (a chat on a host that's up)

parts.name: Agent Management row
parts.shows: The capability's row as Settings → Access has it: its button names who may (Same as Host while the chat has no rule of its own) and opens a check "Same as Host" above the Settings checklist (Everybody over a check per member). While Same as Host is checked, the list shows the host's rule. On the phone the name sits on a line above the button.

actions.does: Sends access_set {session, rule} at once: a member or Everybody checked or unchecked gives the chat its own rule (Same as Host goes off); unchecking Same as Host keeps the host's rule as the chat's own; checking it sends rule null, the host's rule again.

decisions.said: Existing agent management, with individual chats able to override the policy (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app that lists a host's chats with a row menu offers Access… on a chat, setting that chat's own manage rule, kept by its host and enforced there

decisions.said: Each capability showing two dropdowns is odd; who may should be read off a group-like list (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: A chat's own access rule is the same one control as the host's: Same as Host is a check above the members' checklist, not a dropdown entry

parts.name: Close
parts.shows: "Close": the dialog has nothing to save, each change is sent as it is made.
